simple.meaning: יְקוֹד (yᵉqôwd) is a Hebrew word meaning “a burning.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יְקוֹד (H3350) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 10:16, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְקוֹד (H3350) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יְקוֹד (H3350) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יְקוֹד (yᵉqôwd) / H3350 is traced through Isaiah 10:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3350. yeqod יְקוֺד noun [masculine] a burning (properly Infinitive construct of יָקַד ) — only Isa 10:16 , absolute and construct, figurative of ׳י s judgment, see [ יָקַד ] above

occurrences.englishText: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
